pageLabels.title: تسميات الصفحات
pageLabels.intro: اكتب اسم الصفحة في الحقل. يلتقط «{{select}}» نصًا من الصفحة: يُدرج بالشكل {OCR1} و{OCR2}… ويُقرأ من المكان نفسه في كل صفحة. مثال: {OCR1} - {OCR2}
pageLabels.name: اسم الصفحة:
pageLabels.pickHint: اسحب مربعًا حول النص المطلوب، مثل رقم اللوحة. اضغط Esc للإلغاء.

pageLabels.ocrLegend: الصفحات المعلّمة بـ OCR قُرئت بالتعرف على النص؛ تحقق منها قبل التطبيق.

recovery.title: استعادة العمل غير المحفوظ
recovery.intro: لم يُغلق Open PDF Studio بشكل طبيعي في المرة السابقة. تم الاحتفاظ بالعمل غير المحفوظ لهذه المستندات:
recovery.originalChanged: تغيّر الملف الأصلي منذ ذلك الحين.
recovery.keepNote: ما لا تعالجه الآن يُحتفظ به لمدة 14 يومًا ويُعرض عليك مجددًا عند التشغيل التالي.
recovery.tabTip: تمت الاستعادة بعد إغلاق غير متوقع. الحفظ يكتب في الملف الأصلي.
recovery.reloadStopped: توقفت نافذة Open PDF Studio عن العمل عدة مرات متتالية ولم تعد تُعاد تحميلها تلقائيًا. احفظ عملك وأعد تشغيل التطبيق.

protectPdf.title: الحماية بكلمة مرور
protectPdf.info: يحفظ نسخة محمية من هذا المستند؛ ويبقى المستند المفتوح دون تغيير. تستخدم النسخة تشفير AES-256 القياسي وتُفتح في أي قارئ PDF باستخدام كلمة المرور.
protectPdf.openPasswordHint: بدونها لا يُفتح المستند. اتركها فارغة ليتمكن أي شخص من فتحه.
protectPdf.rightsPasswordHint: مطلوبة لرفع القيود أدناه. إذا تُركت فارغة فلن يستطيع أحد رفعها.
protectPdf.rightsWarning: لا تلتزم كل البرامج بهذه الأذونات. كلمة مرور الفتح وحدها تحافظ على خصوصية المحتوى.
protectPdf.needPassword: أدخل كلمة مرور واحدة على الأقل.
protectPdf.samePassword: استخدم كلمة مرور للفتح تختلف عن كلمة مرور تغيير الأذونات.
protectPdf.saveFirst: يجب حفظ المستند قبل إنشاء نسخة محمية. هل تريد حفظه الآن؟
protectPdf.tooShort: يجب أن تتكون كلمة المرور من 6 أحرف على الأقل. استخدم 12 أو أكثر إن أمكن.
protectPdf.tooLong: يمكن أن يبلغ طول كلمة المرور 127 بايت على الأكثر. يشغل كل حرف غير لاتيني أو حرف بعلامة من 2 إلى 4 بايت.
protectPdf.notPortable: تحتوي كلمة المرور هذه على أحرف تعاملها قارئات PDF بطرق مختلفة، مثل الأحرف كاملة العرض أو المسافات الخاصة أو الأحرف غير المرئية وأحرف التحكم. اكتبها بدونها.
protectPdf.errorEncrypted: ملف PDF هذا محمي بكلمة مرور بالفعل.
protectPdf.errorIncomplete: تعذّرت قراءة كل أجزاء ملف PDF هذا، لذلك لم تُنشأ نسخة محمية. احفظ المستند باستخدام "حفظ باسم" ثم حاول مرة أخرى.

hiddenInformation.title: Inspect hidden information
hiddenInformation.scope: Inspect the loaded, saved PDF. Save pending changes first. Export always creates a new file.
hiddenInformation.effects: Removing comments deletes non-widget annotations, including visible markups and links. Removing actions disables navigation and form actions. Every copy is rewritten; existing signatures will no longer validate.
hiddenInformation.limits: Hidden layers, invisible or covered text, image pixels and unknown private content are not removed. This is selective structural cleanup, not a guarantee that all confidential content is gone. PDF/A and PDF/X require independent validation.
hiddenInformation.done: Copy verified by reopening and inspecting its object graph.
hiddenInformation.error: Could not complete. Save pending changes and choose a new output filename.

preflight.title: Print preflight
preflight.scope: Inspect the saved PDF. Save pending changes first. Findings identify pages and resource paths; profiles are stored on this device.
preflight.name: Profile name
preflight.notCertified: Profile findings; not a PDF/X or PDF/A certificate. Inline images, annotation appearances, complex color spaces, patterns and shadings require external validation.
preflight.fixEffect: Set every TrimBox to the CropBox clipped to the MediaBox in a new copy, then recheck. Other findings remain. Rewriting invalidates existing digital signatures.
preflight.fix: Save copy with corrected trim boxes
preflight.error: Could not complete. Check the profile, save changes and choose a new filename.
preflight.stale: The document changed. Inspect it again.

ocrReview.title: Verify OCR
ocrReview.instructions: Review uncertain words against the source crop. Alt+Left/Right navigates; Enter accepts or corrects the text. Save to update searchable/copied text. The scan is never painted over.
ocrReview.empty: No review candidates. Run OCR first, or raise the threshold. Older PDFs without review metadata need OCR again.
ocrReview.error: Could not update verification. Refresh the queue if the document changed.

portfolio.title: PDF collection portfolio
portfolio.info: Edit a copy of the saved PDF. Save pending document edits first. A new collection gets a fallback cover page. Existing schema, sorting and item metadata are retained. Saving a copy invalidates digital signatures; components are never executed.
portfolio.name: Component

errors.DOCUMENT_CHANGED: The source document changed. Close and reopen this dialog.
errors.SAVE_CHANGES_FIRST: Save pending edits before opening the portfolio.
errors.INVALID_NAME: Enter a name without path separators.
errors.DUPLICATE_COMPONENT: A component with this name already exists in the folder.
errors.PDF_PREVIEW_ONLY: Only PDF files can be previewed. Export this component instead.

formRecognition.title: Recognize form fields
formRecognition.info: Detect possible fields, review each proposal and accept the ones to keep. This is heuristic recognition, not a guarantee. Save source edits first. The fillable copy preserves artwork; rewriting invalidates signatures. Existing fields are retained.
formRecognition.ocr: Use desktop OCR for labels on scans
formRecognition.noLabels: Page {{page}} has no text labels. Enable OCR or enter labels manually.
formRecognition.name: Unique field name
formRecognition.label: Accessible field label
formRecognition.coordinates: Bounds in unrotated PDF points (origin bottom left). Existing fields keep their order.
formRecognition.previewLabel: Page preview with selected field outline

errors.DOCUMENT_CHANGED: The source changed. Close and reopen recognition.
errors.INVALID_BOUNDS: Field bounds must stay inside the page.
errors.OVERLAPPING_FIELDS: Accepted fields overlap existing or other accepted fields.
errors.INVALID_OR_DUPLICATE_NAME: Enter a unique field/group name without periods.

symbolSearch.title: Find repeated symbols
symbolSearch.info: Drag a rectangle around a symbol in the preview, choose pages and review matches. Matching uses page artwork without markups, up to 1,200 pixels per page edge. Templates must span 6–160 search pixels. Scores are visual similarity, not certainty. Counts are created only for accepted matches.
symbolSearch.canvas: Page preview; drag to select a template
symbolSearch.truncated: Result limit reached. Search fewer pages or increase similarity.

errors.DOCUMENT_CHANGED: The document changed. Close and reopen symbol search.
errors.TEMPLATE_BOUNDS: Choose a rectangle inside the page, spanning 6–160 pixels at search resolution.
errors.TEMPLATE_NEEDS_CONTRAST: Choose a symbol with foreground and background detail.
errors.INVALID_TOLERANCE: Similarity must be 0.5–1; scale 0.5–2 and rotation a quarter turn.
errors.READ_ONLY: This document or markup layer is read-only.

workbookBindings.title: Spreadsheet quantity bindings
workbookBindings.info: Map numeric schedule totals to XLSX cells. Refresh updates only mapped cells and requests recalculation on opening the workbook. Formulas, merged/protected targets, macros and signed workbooks are refused. Open the exact source PDF before refresh. Desktop refresh updates the workbook atomically; the browser downloads a copy.
workbookBindings.name: Binding name
workbookBindings.mapping: Enter a cell address for each total to map. Leave other totals empty.
workbookBindings.rebind: Rebind to active source and settings
workbookBindings.bound: Binding saved; refresh explicitly to write values.
workbookBindings.copyReady: Refreshed copy downloaded. The bound file was not overwritten.

errors.OPEN_SOURCE_DOCUMENT: Open the bound source document first.
errors.RESELECT_WORKBOOK: Select this binding and choose its workbook file again.
errors.MIXED_UNITS: The mapped total mixes incompatible units.
errors.UNIT_CHANGED: The source unit changed. Rebind explicitly.
errors.FORMULA_TARGET: A mapped cell contains a formula or belongs to an array formula.
errors.WORKBOOK_CHANGED: The workbook changed during refresh. Retry.
errors.REBIND_SCHEDULE: The schedule changed. Review and rebind.
errors.DUPLICATE_TARGET: Another mapping already owns this cell.
errors.SOURCE_FILE_CHANGED: The PDF on disk no longer matches this open version. Reopen the source document.
errors.SIGNED_OR_MACRO_WORKBOOK: Signed and macro-enabled workbooks are not supported.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_WORKSHEET_XML: This worksheet structure is not supported.
errors.MERGED_TARGET: Choose a cell outside a merged range.

workflows.title: Document workflows
workflows.help: Set a name, output suffix and ordered steps. Save your workflow or export/import it. Choose a sample PDF to download a processed preview. Empty document properties clear those values.
workflows.limits: Desktop batch runs preserve inputs and publish new files only. Output names include a content/settings hash; reruns skip identical completed outputs. Folder watching runs only while this app is open, waits for two stable checks and an EOF marker, and ignores generated outputs. Use a separate output folder on a filesystem with hard-link support. Encrypted PDFs and certified documents are refused. Rewriting may invalidate other digital signatures; use unsigned inputs.
workflows.failed: The operation failed. Check the workflow, selected files and folders. Batch error codes appear in the log.
workflows.name: Workflow name

drawingSets.title: Drawing sets
drawingSets.help: Keep a portable register of separate PDF sheets. Sources are never merged or rewritten. Open source PDFs, capture pages into a proposed package and review every replacement before committing. A package is a full issue: sheets omitted from it are marked absent, with their history retained.
drawingSets.name: Set name
drawingSets.transferHelp: Open both revisions using the register and leave the target active. Supported: rectangles, circles, straight lines/arrows, simple polygons and comments. Other markups are reported as unsupported. Page size/rotation are mapped; review all placements and optional offsets. Red outlines show selected target bounds, not final appearance. Existing IDs are skipped; replies get coherent new IDs. Apply changes only to the active document; save it explicitly.

sheetLinks.title: Cross-sheet links
sheetLinks.help: Capture the open saved PDFs as a package, select sources and edit their destination labels. Scan text references, review each source and target, then select links to export. The ZIP keeps PDF filenames and relative links together; originals stay unchanged.
sheetLinks.limits: Text-based PDFs and existing OCR text layers are supported. Run OCR first for scans. Substring bounds are approximate and need visual review. A literal prefix also finds missing target labels. Optional detail regions use unrotated PDF coordinates: left, bottom, right, top. Unsaved edits must be saved first. Rewriting signed PDFs can invalidate signatures.
sheetLinks.label: Sheet / detail label
sheetLinks.replace: Replace existing links overlapping selected references
sheetLinks.export: Export selected links and PDFs as ZIP

approvalRouting.title: Approval routing
approvalRouting.help: Prepare an exact saved PDF version, assign recipients and review regions, and release a package for manual handoff. Drafting never sends or uploads a file. Sequential requests require an updated package after each receipt; parallel requests can be handed to all recipients.
approvalRouting.distinction: This adapter records self-reported electronic approvals. It does not apply drawn signatures, authenticate recipients, or create/validate certificate signatures. The approved PDF remains the exact source file. No legal-validity claim is made.
approvalRouting.integrity: The audit hash chain detects inconsistent edits and binds receipts to the PDF hash. It does not prove sender identity, delivery, trusted time or authenticity against a rewritten chain. Keep exported audit copies independently.
approvalRouting.configure: Explicitly enable the local file handoff adapter
approvalRouting.draft: New draft from active saved PDF
approvalRouting.name: Request title
approvalRouting.fieldsHelp: Optional approval regions use displayed page points. They are review instructions, not PDF signature fields; no PDF content is changed.
approvalRouting.manual: Manual handoff; delivery is not tracked
approvalRouting.receiptHelp: Load request.json and document.pdf from the received package. Review the exact PDF and select the identity you report. Return the receipt JSON to the request owner. No message is sent by this application.
approvalRouting.confirmReceipt: I reviewed this document and report the selected recipient’s decision; identity is not verified by the app.
